data.description: Original Protocol J3R-MC-YDAF for ENLIGHTEN-2 Phase 3 study of eloralintide in participants with obesity or overweight and Type 2 Diabetes

Protocol Amendment (a) - nonsubstantial amendment addressing feedback from internal safety committee. Changes include updates to Exclusion Criteria (Section 5.2) regarding insulin use restrictions, Section 6.9.1 adding insulin prohibition for 14+ consecutive days, Section 6.9.2 updating rescue therapy language and insulin provisions, and Section 6.9.3 clarifying short-term insulin use note. Electronically Signed and Approved by Lilly. Document ID: VV-CLIN-198891. IND: 158631. EU trial number: 2025-523658-15-00.
